pages.text: TM-186, 1st printing Glare-Reduction Kit for Warlords™ This kit greatly decreases the reflections pro- duced by the monitor shield that was originally in- stalled in your Warlords™ upright game. The kit also improves the bass response of the audio by making the below-mirror area a resonating chamber. The triangular spacers in this kit should be used to prevent players from pushing the shield back- wards into the game. The contents of this modifications kit are: Part No. Quantity Description A037656-01 1 Anti-Glare Shield & Grille Assembly 037539-02 1 Left Shield Spacer 037533-03 1 Right Shield Spacer Retrofit Instructions: 1. Open the coin door. Remove the wing nuts and other hardware that secure the control panel; swing out the panel. 2. Pull the bottom edge of the monitor shield towards you: remove the shield and discard it. 3. Remove the protective paper from the foam tape on one of the triangular spacers. Note that the long pointed comer of the spacer should point down towards the control panel. 4. Position the spacer against the top rear corner, flush with the wood speaker panel. Then firmly press the spacer against the inside of the cabinet wail, as shown in the illustration. Apply the other spacer in the same manner to the opposite wall. 5. Remove the three Allen-head screws that se- cure the lower attraction panel retainer. Remove the attraction panel. Loosen the upper attraction-panel retainer. 6. Insert the shield assembly into the position of the old shield—flush against the two spacers. Close the control panel: make sure to push the control Panel tight against the lower edge of the acrylic shield before completely tightening the wing nuts. Lock the panel in place with the hardware. Close and lock the game’s coin door. 7. Insert the attraction panel under the upper re- tainer, and reinstall the lower retainer with its three Allen-head screws. Continued on reverse side A.
